section.content: 本发明公开了种生物技术基因检测装置，包括工作台、检测箱、试管和基因检测模块，所述检测箱设置在工作台上，所述检测箱内对应开启门体设置有滑槽，所述滑槽上活动设置有试管卡板，且试管卡板上均匀设置有若干个试管卡口，所述试管放置在试管卡口内，所述检测箱顶部通过接口设置有输液管，所述接口的输入端连接有抽液泵和抽水泵，所述抽液泵的输出端通过连接管与基因检测模块连接，所述抽水泵的输入端通过进水管连接有净水箱，所述抽水泵的输入端与抽液泵的输出端电性连接。该生物技术基因检测装置，操作方便，降低试管内液体受到污染的可能性，提高液体基因检测的准确度。

The invention discloses a gene detection device adopting biotechnology. The gene detection device comprises a working platform, a detection box, test tubes and a gene detection module, wherein the detection box is arranged on the working platform; a sliding groove, in correspondence to an open door body, is formed in the detection box; a test tube clamping plate is movably arranged on the sliding groove and a plurality of test tube bayonets are uniformly formed in the test tube clamping plate; the test tubes are arranged in the test tube bayonets; infusion tubes are arranged at the top of the detection box by virtue of an interface; a liquid pump and a water pump are connected to an input end of the interface; an output end of the liquid pump is connected to the gene detection module by virtue of a connecting tube; an input end of the water pump is connected to a water purifying tank by virtue of a water inlet tube; and an input end of the water pump is electrically connected to the output end of the liquid pump. The gene detection device adopting the biotechnology is convenient to operate, and the gene detection device can reduce the possibility that liquid in the test tubes gets contaminated and can improve the accuracy of liquid gene detection.

A kind of biotechnology gene assaying deviceTechnical field

The invention belongs to technical field of biological is and in particular to a kind of biotechnology gene assaying device.

Background technology

In biological technical field, gene test is the important means of life studies, does universal during gene detection assay at present Using the method for unimolecule gene sequencing, and the fluid control device of unimolecule gene sequencing is the crucial mould of unimolecule tester Block, the gene chip in the fluid control device of unimolecule gene sequencing is by the core of biochemical reaction and optical imagery Part, the fluid control device of gene sequencing generally arranges multiple fluid delivery device, and this fluid delivery device has to gene core Piece conveys various reaction reagents, controls reagent flow direction and flow, control the mixing of reagent, derive the functions such as waste liquid.Business at present The fluid control device of gene sequencing much adopts negative pressure air pump as power source, but exists in negative pressure air pump system The confined space that gas-liquid two-phase coexists, after negative pressure air pump quits work, due to the presence of confined space negative pressure, fluid does not have Stop, the flow still keeping certain is flowing, and to the last the air pressure of confined space is equal with atmospheric pressure just stops, and leads at once Cause the inaccurate of gene sequencing, waste reaction reagent.
